pattern.description: A collage of rounded video tiles and an SDK icon column drifts slowly upward while the 'Purchase confirmed' pill holds its position in front with a soft gradient glow shifting on its border.
pattern.why_premium: The constant low-speed drift keeps a dense collage alive without competing with the narration, and the foreground pill staying put against the moving back layer gives depth and a clear focal anchor.

build_hint.gsap: Collage group: gsap.to('.collage', {y: '-=12', duration: 4, ease: 'none'}) as a continuous drift, icons inside the same group; pill on a separate layer: gsap.to('.pill-glow', {backgroundPosition: '100% 0', duration: 1.2, ease: 'sine.inOut', repeat: -1, yoyo: true}). Videos autoplay in tiles.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 120], [0, -12], {extrapolateRight: 'extend'}) on the collage container (linear); pill glow gradient angle interpolated with Easing.inOut(Easing.sin); <OffthreadVideo> in each tile.

notes: Very low-energy burst (100 ms); motion is a subtle drift plus in-tile video playback. Camera verdict none, so the small pan_y is content drift, not a camera move. Pill change is a faint border glow shift and may be compression noise.
